name: Channel9
purpose: Mixing-desk channel: choose a Neve, API, SSL, Teac or Mackie voicing with drive; a more coloured console option than Console8.
avoid_for: material that must stay completely untouched

params.name: Console
params.ai_hint: Neve: smooth, extended highs, a good vocal choice. API: punchy and forward. SSL: tight, brighter, steeper top. Teac: dark, vibey, gritty low-end. Mackie: leaner and brighter, grindy and lo-fi.

params.name: Drive
params.ai_hint: Drive into the console stages. 0 is subtle colour only; 0.2-0.4 adds warmth and density; 0.6+ is obvious saturation and louder.

params.name: Output
params.ai_hint: Output level. 1.0 is unity; lower it if drive makes the sound louder.

notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1 except the console type, which Plugsalot presents as a choice.
Calibrated to give the general sense of each desk rather than clone it.
CPU: 0.22% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
